apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Native WKWebView browser baseline
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS WKWebView browser for sideloading. No DDG entitlements, no extensions, no app groups. Includes URL/search bar, navigation, share, persistent WKWebsiteDataStore, Agent Snapshot, Keychain API settings, OpenAI-compatible Ask Page, extract forms/links, fill/click CSS selector tools, and custom JS probe.
apps.versionDescription: Max Agent build: Keychain API key storage, OpenAI-compatible chat completions, Ask Page, summarize, page snapshot with forms/links, CSS selector fill/click tools, and custom JS probe.
